Unmodified single-file audio library from the official repository:
https://github.com/mackron/miniaudio/tree/0.11.26

File: miniaudio.h (version 0.11.26)
SHA-256: 6b376c7fbb1352ba1e0e432ab66069b335ea9405e45cb6c30b97ef0f3c9c3e0e

Used only by the Linux/macOS terminal app (src/cli*.h, src/cli.cpp, src/audio_backend.*)
for microphone capture and playback into the virtual microphone. The Windows effect does
not use it. Dual-licensed public domain / MIT No Attribution; the full text is at the end
of miniaudio.h and is shipped as MINIAUDIO-LICENSE.txt.
